faq.q: What is the origin of Hossam?
faq.a: Hossam is associated with Arabic. Hossam is Arabic حُسَام (Ḥusām), meaning 'sharp sword'.
Yes — the underlying form حُسَام is Arabic.
Hossam can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hossam should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥusām is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Hossam mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hossam is rendered حسام and carries the sense حسام، شمشیر برنده.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Hossam, hossam. Script forms are حسام, حُسَام, हुसाम.

faq.q: Is Hossam a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
